_comment_scope: Workspace LHCI config. Per performance.md §1 workspace pages are audited on DESKTOP form factor (Anna persona, 2-monitor workstation). H.0 wires React Router so `/queue` is reachable via redirect from `/`; timing-threshold graduation (warn → error) is deferred until MSW or BFF is wired into the CI LHCI run (see `_comment_timing_thresholds`). Other routes stay listed under `_url_todo_phase_h` and graduate as feature chunks (H.7+) ship real content.
_comment_timing_thresholds: Numeric timing thresholds (TTI/LCP) remain `warn` post-H.0. Reason: `staticDistDir` LHCI runs without a BFF, so bootstrap fails at `/config HTTP 404` and LCP measures the bootstrap error fallback. Graduation to `error` requires the static dist to serve `/config` + `/me` (either via MSW-in-LHCI or a stub backend), tracked as an open item for the LHCI infrastructure work. CLS + accessibility + best-practices stay as `error` because they are robust to bootstrap state.

assert._comment_blocking: Blocking assertions — robust against the bootstrap state. CLS + accessibility + best-practices catch obvious regressions.
assert._comment_warn_only: Timing thresholds (TTI, LCP, score) stay `warn` until MSW or stub BFF is wired into CI LHCI runs. Values match performance.md §2 workspace `/queue` desktop.
